oracle: numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.13.1 and astropy 6.0.1 (scipy.special erf, erfc, erfcx; scipy.integrate quad, dblquad; scipy.optimize curve_fit, brentq, minimize_scalar; scipy.ndimage gaussian_filter1d; astropy.modeling LevMarLSQFitter and LinearLSQFitter with Gaussian1D, Linear1D and Chebyshev1D; numpy.linalg.lstsq), Python 3.9.6
identity: An independent implementation, in Python floats, of the pixel area of a Gaussian (erf and erfc), the Planck pixel integral, the relativistic Doppler wavelength, a numerical convolution of a science template (a template sampled at 1/20 of the line-spread sigma, gaussian_filter1d, cumulative-trapezoid pixel averages) with no analytic Gaussian-line shortcut, the reference spectrograph's noisy arc, scipy curve_fit and astropy LevMarLSQFitter fits of its isolated lines, the weighted polynomial solutions by numpy lstsq and by astropy Chebyshev1D, the line signal-to-noise discrete sum, the slit throughput by dblquad and the resolving-power optimum by minimize_scalar. No Gravitas code ran; the only repository input is the line pack's numbers, parsed as text from js/data/radiation/lines.js.
selfCheck: Before any kernel code existed the fits were compared with the truth: the 14 isolated lines' fitted centres lie within 2.6 reported sigma of the truth pixel, their widths are 1.187 to 1.220 pixel against the truth 1.213, their reduced chi-squares are at most 1.67; the astropy Chebyshev solution equals the numpy one to 1e-4 nm or better; the dblquad throughput equals the erf closed form to 1e-12. The first run found two lines contaminated by a neighbour inside the fit window (reduced chi-square 1894 and 363) and the isolation rule was strengthened (amendment AM2); H-alpha lies outside the detector (AM1). A second revision (amendment AM4) rounded the A2 cases' inputs to the file's 12 digits before computing their values: the first version computed the value from full-precision inputs and then wrote rounded inputs, so any implementation evaluated on the stored inputs differed by about 1e-11. Only the a2 block changed; every other block is byte-identical (checked).
installedPackages: specutils, specreduce, PypeIt and rascal are not installed and nothing was downloaded: the 'cited reduction routine' is astropy.modeling's linear least-squares fitter with Chebyshev1D (what specutils, specreduce and ccdproc call for a dispersion function) and numpy's least squares
note: PyYAML is not installed; astropy.table imports it at load though modeling never reads YAML, so the script puts an empty module in its place before the import. Nothing was installed or downloaded.
run: cd <empty scratchpad directory>; python3 <repo>/tools/spectrograph-oracle/oracle.py OUT.json; then Prettier
